briefdescription.para: YOLOv8 object detection plugin – ONNX Runtime backend.

detaileddescription.para: The implementation is divided into two compilation paths:

listitem.para: With ONNX Runtime (HAVE_ONNXRUNTIME defined): a real ONNX Runtime session is created and YOLOv8 post-processing (box decoding + NMS) is performed in this file.

Without ONNX Runtime (default): every detectObjects() call returns a well-formed DetectionResult with success = false and an explanatory error_message. This path is used in unit-test builds and environments where ONNX Runtime is not installed.

sect2.title: YOLOv8 output tensor layout (when HAVE_ONNXRUNTIME)
sect2.para:
The standard YOLOv8 detection export produces a single output tensor of shape [1, 84, 8400] (for 640×640 input):
Axis 1 index 0-3: cx, cy, w, h (centre-format, in pixels)
Axis 1 index 4-83: class confidence scores (80 COCO classes)

Post-processing steps:
Transpose to [8400, 84] for cache-friendly iteration.
For each anchor: objectness = max(class_confs); skip if < threshold.
Convert cx/cy/w/h → x1/y1/x2/y2 and normalise to [0, 1].
Apply greedy NMS per class (IoU threshold from config).
Cap total detections at max_detections.
